what: The source is Stripe's Services Agreement, and the record and lines 35, 49 and 50 hold against it and name it as Stripe's ("If Stripe provides Services in countries not listed in this Section 13, then (i) for countries in the Americas, the Regional Terms for the United States apply, and (ii) for countries in the rest of the world, the Regional Terms for Ireland apply."). No record cited in Q2 shows WooCommerce's terms incorporate it; it reaches WooPayments only through the Connected Account Agreement and the uncited WC-S-0507 ("contains the terms you agreed to during the WooPayments signup process"). Settled as for Q2-WC-P0108.

The source is Stripe's own page; its words support lines 36 and 65 ("forms a legal agreement between you or the entity you represent ("User") and the applicable Stripe entity"). That WooCommerce names it rests on WC-S-0507, given in the record's scope but not cited in Q2: "Occasionally, Stripe may update their Connected Account Agreement, which contains the terms you agreed to during the WooPayments signup process." That shows acceptance at signup, not WooCommerce's terms incorporating Stripe's. Settled by the coordinator's ruling on acceptance at signup; citing Q3-WC-K0485 (WC-S-0507) at lines 36 and 65 would show WooCommerce naming the agreement.

The source says "Different Automattic companies are the controller (or co-controller) of personal information" of "the individual using our Services", and goes on: "Depending on the Services you use, more than one company may be the controller of your personal data." Line 38 says which one Automattic company "controls WooCommerce data": wider than personal information of individuals using Automattic's Services, and one company where the source allows more than one. Lines 75 and 142 hold.
fix: Line 38: "Which Automattic companies are controller (or co-controller) of personal information depends 'on the particular service and the location of the individual using our Services', and more than one may be".

what: The source is WooPayments' documentation of local payment methods: "If these requirements are not met, the payment method will be hidden since the customer cannot use it anyway", the requirements being the customer billing country and currency.
